packs.title: Lake, Art and Living City
packs.promise: Explore Cleveland across separate lakefront, cultural and neighborhood outings.

q.s: Trace one musician's choices through a displayed object.
st: Choose a credited object in an open exhibit and note its artist or maker.
Record one visible detail that helps explain how a sound or performance was made.
Make a short original sound-map or written interpretation, separating the display's facts from your inference.

q.s: Compose the lake and city as two changing layers.
st: Choose a safe public viewpoint with lake and built shoreline in the frame.
Draw or describe two horizon layers and one detail that changes with weather or light.
Make an original postcard composition from those observations without copying signs or another artist.

q.s: Compare a visual choice across two credited works.
st: Choose two works in open permanent galleries and note each maker or collection label.
Record one difference in material, shape or color that you can actually see.
Write an original comparison that distinguishes observation from a claim about the makers' intentions.

packs.title: Civic Core Walk
packs.promise: Walk downtown Cleveland through public spaces, architecture, memory and performance.

q.s: Map how a civic landscape makes room to move and pause.
st: From an open path, identify two ways into Public Square.
Choose one place to pause without blocking a crossing or event.
Draw a small movement map with the two approaches and the pause point.

q.s: Observe how a short pedestrian corridor works like a room.
st: From a legal public point, notice the street's entrances and one place people gather.
Mark a clear route through without walking through occupied seating.
Describe how the corridor's width, signs or lighting shape that route.

q.s: Read a library object as a map rather than a decoration.
st: Check the library's current access and find an open lobby or self-guided-tour feature.
Record one labeled detail of the Terrestrial Globe light fixture or another currently open map display.
Make one original map question that the observed detail does not answer.
